Senior BIM Modeler - VIC Electrical Team   
  About the Opportunity  
  An integral role has opened within the VIC Electrical team of a leading services provider. We are seeking a highly motivated and technically proficient BIM Modeler to facilitate, lead, and coordinate the process of generating digital models and integrated data from the design stage through to construction.  
  This is a dynamic, hands-on role for a dedicated individual who can be the go-to technical expert for project-specific modeling setup, cross-discipline coordination, and efficient issue resolution.  
  Key Responsibilities  
  As the Electrical BIM Modeler, you will be the cornerstone of our digital project delivery, responsible for:  
 
  BIM Leadership: Conducting the lead electrical BIM coordinator role for significant projects.  
  Model Management: Setting up, managing, and maintaining the electrical model, ensuring it is correct and up-to-date in accordance with the BIM Execution Plan (BEP).  
  Documentation & Production: Producing and developing high-quality 3D documentation in Revit MEP and AutoCAD for electrical projects.  
  Coordination & Clash Detection: Actively leading coordination between electrical and other services. Performing comprehensive clash detection using tools like Navisworks and Revizto.  
  Data Integrity: Managing drawing registers, submitting drawings to clients, and ensuring linking of information across disciplines.  
  Stakeholder Liaison: Liaising effectively with project and engineering teams to update and modify the model based on project needs and engineer recommendations.  
  Quality & Standards: Ensuring work is delivered to a high standard, within required time frames, and maintaining project content (such as family setups). Experience on projects up to LOD400 is required.  
  Technical Support: Providing technical support and mentorship to the project team, leveraging your proficiency in BIM tools.  
  Workflow: Coordinating and managing the BIM project data sets, workflow, and daily model administration.  
 
  Core Competencies & Values   
  Our Values & Your Alignment  
 
  Innovation: You embrace change, adopt a growth mindset, and are ready to adapt to new procedures and technologies.  
  Integrity: You are accountable, operate with honesty and certainty, and competently manage sensitive and confidential information.  
  Commercial: You are a problem solver who anticipates needs, uses initiative, and delivers work to meet project requirements and deadlines.  
  Safety: You prioritize Health and Safety by promoting a safe workplace, stopping unsafe practices, and promptly raising/reporting all HSEQ concerns.  
 
  Essential Skills  
 
  Motivated and Reliable  : Demonstrating excellent attention to detail, even when working at pace and to short time frames.  
  Teamwork:   Able to work autonomously yet communicate effectively, offering cross-team support and understanding the organisational impact of the role.  
  Communication  : Collaborates well when needed and can use written and verbal communications competently and listens well.  
 
  Next Steps  
  If you are a technically strong BIM Modeler ready to take the lead on challenging electrical projects and embody these values, we encourage you to apply.  

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background.
